name: void-blaster
description: Neon space survivor for iPhone and Android

scripts.xcode: node scripts/build.mjs && npx cap sync ios && npx cap open ios
scripts.ios: node scripts/build.mjs && npx cap sync ios
scripts.ios:release: node scripts/build.mjs --release && npx cap sync ios
scripts.android: node scripts/build.mjs && npx cap sync android
scripts.android:open: node scripts/build.mjs && npx cap sync android && npx cap open android
scripts.proto2: python3 proto2/make-assets.py && python3 proto2/make-ships.py && python3 proto2/make-world1.py && python3 proto2/make-world2.py && node proto2/build.mjs
